name: ZMod.isSquare_neg_one_of_eq_sq_add_sq_of_isCoprime
informal: If the integer `n` is a sum of two squares of coprime integers, then `-1` is a square modulo `n`.
signature: {n x y : ℤ} (h : n = x ^ 2 + y ^ 2) (hc : IsCoprime x y) : IsSquare (-1 : ZMod n.natAbs)

name: Prime.pow_inj
informal: Two prime powers with positive exponents are equal only when the primes and the exponents are equal.
signature: {p q m n : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime) (h : p ^ (m + 1) = q ^ (n + 1)) : p = q ∧ m = n

name: head_add_length_le_nat
informal: In ℕ, the head and tail of an `LTSeries` differ at least by the length of the series
signature: (p : LTSeries ℕ) : p.head + p.length ≤ p.last

name: factorMultiset_ofPrime
informal: Factoring a prime gives the corresponding one-element multiset.
signature: (p : Nat.Primes) : (p : ℕ+).factorMultiset = PrimeMultiset.ofPrime p

name: IsTopologicalSemiring.toIsTopologicalRing
informal: If `R` is a ring which is a topological semiring, then it is automatically a topological ring. This exists so that one can place a topological ring structure on `R` without explicitly proving `continuous_neg`.
signature: [TopologicalSpace R] [NonAssocRing R] (_ : IsTopologicalSemiring R) : IsTopologicalRing R where toContinuousNeg

name: extend_partialOrder
informal: **Szpilrajn extension theorem**: any partial order can be extended to a linear order.
signature: {α : Type u} (r : α → α → Prop) [IsPartialOrder α r] : ∃ s : α → α → Prop, IsLinearOrder α s ∧ r ≤ s

name: young_inequality
informal: **Young's inequality**, `ℝ≥0` version. We use `{p q : ℝ≥0}` in order to avoid constructing witnesses of `0 ≤ p` and `0 ≤ q` for the denominators.
signature: (a b : ℝ≥0) {p q : ℝ≥0} (hpq : p.HolderConjugate q) : a * b ≤ a ^ (p : ℝ) / p + b ^ (q : ℝ) / q

name: convexOn_of_deriv2_nonneg
informal: If a function `f` is continuous on a convex set `D ⊆ ℝ`, is twice differentiable on its interior, and `f''` is nonnegative on the interior, then `f` is convex on `D`.
signature: {D : Set ℝ} (hD : Convex ℝ D) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f D) (hf' : DifferentiableOn ℝ f (interior D)) (hf'' : DifferentiableOn ℝ (deriv f) (interior D)) (hf''_nonneg : ∀ x ∈ interior D, 0 ≤ deriv^[2] f x) : ConvexOn ℝ D f

name: le_of_embedding
informal: If we have an embedding from `Fin m` to `Fin n`, then `m ≤ n`. See also `Fintype.card_le_of_embedding` for the generalisation to arbitrary finite types.
signature: (f : Fin m ↪ Fin n) : m ≤ n

name: nhdsNE_of_nhdsNE_sdiff_finite
informal: In a T1Space, punctured neighborhoods are stable under removing finite sets of points.
signature: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [T1Space X] {x : X} {U s : Set X} (hU : U ∈ 𝓝[≠] x) (hs : Finite s) : U \ s ∈ 𝓝[≠] x

name: strictConcaveOn_of_deriv2_neg
informal: If a function `f` is continuous on a convex set `D ⊆ ℝ` and `f''` is strictly negative on the interior, then `f` is strictly concave on `D`. Note that we don't require twice differentiability explicitly as it already implied by the second derivative being strictly negative, except at at most one point.
signature: {D : Set ℝ} (hD : Convex ℝ D) {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ContinuousOn f D) (hf'' : ∀ x ∈ interior D, deriv^[2] f x < 0) : StrictConcaveOn ℝ D f

name: isUnit_iff_not_dvd_char_of_ringChar_ne_zero
informal: A prime `p` is a unit in a commutative ring `R` of nonzero characteristic iff it does not divide the characteristic.
signature: (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hR : ringChar R ≠ 0) : IsUnit (p : R) ↔ ¬p ∣ ringChar R

name: OrderIso.map_tsub
informal: An order isomorphism between types with ordered subtraction preserves subtraction provided that it preserves addition.
signature: {M N : Type*} [Preorder M] [Add M] [Sub M] [OrderedSub M] [PartialOrder N] [Add N] [Sub N] [OrderedSub N] (e : M ≃o N) (h_add : ∀ a b, e (a + b) = e a + e b) (a b : M) : e (a - b) = e a - e b

name: NNReal.lintegral_mul_le_Lp_mul_Lq
informal: Hölder's inequality for functions `α → ℝ≥0`. The integral of the product of two functions is bounded by the product of their `ℒp` and `ℒq` seminorms when `p` and `q` are conjugate exponents.
signature: {p q : ℝ} (hpq : p.HolderConjugate q) {f g : α → ℝ≥0} (hf : AEMeasurable f μ) (hg : AEMeasurable g μ) : (∫⁻ a, (f * g) a ∂μ) ≤ (∫⁻ a, (f a : ℝ≥0∞) ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / p) * (∫⁻ a, (g a : ℝ≥0∞) ^ q ∂μ) ^ (1 / q)

name: Nat.Primes.summable_rpow
informal: The series over `p^r` for primes `p` converges if and only if `r < -1`.
signature: {r : ℝ} : Summable (fun p : Nat.Primes ↦ (p : ℝ) ^ r) ↔ r < -1

name: summable_indicator_mod_iff_summable_indicator_mod
informal: If a decreasing sequence of real numbers is summable on one residue class modulo `m`, then it is also summable on every other residue class mod `m`.
signature: {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] {f : ℕ → ℝ} (hf : Antitone f) {k : ZMod m} (l : ZMod m) (hs : Summable ({n : ℕ | (n : ZMod m) = k}.indicator f)) : Summable ({n : ℕ | (n : ZMod m) = l}.indicator f)

name: succ_dvd_centralBinom
informal: A crucial lemma to ensure that Catalan numbers can be defined via their explicit formula `catalan n = n.centralBinom / (n + 1)`.
signature: (n : ℕ) : n + 1 ∣ n.centralBinom

name: Nat.range_mul_add
informal: The range of `(m * · + k)` on natural numbers is the set of elements `≥ k` in the residue class of `k` mod `m`.
signature: (m k : ℕ) : Set.range (fun n : ℕ ↦ m * n + k) = {n : ℕ | (n : ZMod m) = k ∧ k ≤ n}

name: imp_forall_iff
informal: We intentionally restrict the type of `α` in this lemma so that this is a safer to use in simp than `forall_comm`.
signature: {α : Type*} {p : Prop} {q : α → Prop} : (p → ∀ x, q x) ↔ ∀ x, p → q x

name: nonempty_orderEmbedding_of_finite_infinite
informal: Any finite linear order order-embeds into any infinite linear order.
signature: (α : Type*) [LinearOrder α] [hα : Finite α] (β : Type*) [LinearOrder β] [hβ : Infinite β] : Nonempty (α ↪o β)

name: discreteTopology_or_nontriviallyNormedField
informal: A normed field is either nontrivially normed or has a discrete topology. In the discrete topology case, all the norms are 1, by `norm_eq_one_iff_ne_zero_of_discrete`. The nontrivially normed field instance is provided by a subtype with a proof that the forgetful inheritance to the existing `NormedField` instance is definitionally true. This allows one to have the new `NontriviallyNormedField` instance without data clashes.
signature: (𝕜 : Type*) [h : NormedField 𝕜] : DiscreteTopology 𝕜 ∨ Nonempty ({h' : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜 // h'.toNormedField = h})

name: card_unique
informal: Any two enumerations of the same type have the same length.
signature: {α : Type u} (e₁ e₂ : FinEnum α) : e₁.card = e₂.card

name: inv_eq_self_iff
informal: In the unit group of an integral domain, a unit is its own inverse iff the unit is one or one's additive inverse.
signature: [Ring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (u : Rˣ) : u⁻¹ = u ↔ u = 1 ∨ u = -1

name: isClosedMap
informal: Any continuous function on compact Hausdorff spaces is a closed map.
signature: {X Y : CompHausLike.{u} P} (f : X ⟶ Y) : IsClosedMap f

name: image_nontrivial_iff_of_injOn
informal: A finset is nontrivial iff its image under a function injective on the finset is.
signature: (hf : Set.InjOn f s) : (s.image f).Nontrivial ↔ s.Nontrivial

name: finite_rat_abs_sub_lt_one_div_den_sq
informal: A rational number has only finitely many good rational approximations.
signature: (ξ : ℚ) : {q : ℚ | |ξ - q| < 1 / (q.den : ℚ) ^ 2}.Finite

name: rpow_one_add_le_one_add_mul_self
informal: **Bernoulli's inequality** for real exponents, non-strict version: for `0 ≤ p ≤ 1` and `-1 ≤ s` we have `(1 + s) ^ p ≤ 1 + p * s`.

name: card_range_le
informal: Any map from `Fin m` reaches at most `m` different values. See also `Fintype.card_range_le` for the generalisation to an arbitrary finite type.
signature: {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (f : Fin m → α) : Fintype.card (Set.range f) ≤ m

name: Filter.coprodᵢ_cocompact
informal: **Tychonoff's theorem** formulated in terms of filters: `Filter.cocompact` on an indexed product type `Π d, X d` the `Filter.coprodᵢ` of filters `Filter.cocompact` on `X d`.
signature: {X : ι → Type*} [∀ d, TopologicalSpace (X d)] : (Filter.coprodᵢ fun d => Filter.cocompact (X d)) = Filter.cocompact (∀ d, X d)

name: le_rpow_add
informal: For `0 ≤ x`, the only problematic case in the equality `x ^ y * x ^ z = x ^ (y + z)` is for `x = 0` and `y + z = 0`, where the right-hand side is `1` while the left-hand side can vanish. The inequality is always true, though, and given in this lemma.
signature: {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (y z : ℝ) : x ^ y * x ^ z ≤ x ^ (y + z)

name: Nat.isSemilinearSet_iff_ultimately_periodic
informal: A set of `ℕ` is semilinear if and only if it is ultimately periodic, i.e. periodic after some number `k`.
signature: {s : Set ℕ} : IsSemilinearSet s ↔ ∃ k, ∃ p > 0, ∀ x ≥ k, x ∈ s ↔ x + p ∈ s

name: equiv_free_prod_prod_multiplicative_zmod
informal: The **Structure theorem of finitely generated abelian groups** in a multiplicative version: Any finitely generated abelian group is the product of a power of `ℤ` and a direct product of some `ZMod (p i ^ e i)` for some prime powers `p i ^ e i`.
signature: (G : Type*) [CommGroup G] [hG : Group.FG G] : ∃ (ι j : Type) (_ : Fintype ι) (_ : Fintype j) (p : ι → ℕ) (_ : ∀ i, Nat.Prime <| p i) (e : ι → ℕ), Nonempty <| G ≃* (j → Multiplicative ℤ) × ((i : ι) → Multiplicative (ZMod (p i ^ e i)))

name: maximal_of_isField
informal: If the quotient by an ideal is a field, then the ideal is maximal.
signature: {R} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (hqf : IsField (R ⧸ I)) : I.IsMaximal

name: filter_eq
informal: After filtering out everything that does not equal a given value, at most that value remains. This is equivalent to `filter_eq'` with the equality the other way.
signature: [DecidableEq β] (s : Finset β) (b : β) : s.filter (Eq b) = ite (b ∈ s) {b} ∅

name: set_induction
informal: A subset of `ℕ` containing zero and closed under `Nat.succ` contains all of `ℕ`.
signature: {S : Set ℕ} (hb : 0 ∈ S) (h_ind : ∀ k : ℕ, k ∈ S → k + 1 ∈ S) (n : ℕ) : n ∈ S

name: surjective_of_surjective_of_injective_of_left_exact
informal: A special case of one four lemma such that the left-most term is zero in terms of modules. For a diagram explaining the variables, see the module docstring.
signature: (hi₂ : Function.Surjective i₂) (hi₃ : Function.Injective i₃) (hg₀ : Function.Injective g₁) : Function.Surjective i₁

name: mul_eq_max
informal: If `α` and `β` are infinite types, then the cardinality of `α × β` is the maximum of the cardinalities of `α` and `β`.
signature: {a b : Cardinal} (ha : ℵ₀ ≤ a) (hb : ℵ₀ ≤ b) : a * b = max a b

name: jacobiTheta₂_add_right
informal: The two-variable Jacobi theta function is periodic in `τ` with period 2.
signature: (z τ : ℂ) : jacobiTheta₂ z (τ + 2) = jacobiTheta₂ z τ

name: count_factorMultiset
informal: The number of occurrences of p in the factor multiset of m is the same as the p-adic valuation of m.
signature: (m : ℕ+) (p : Nat.Primes) (k : ℕ) : (p : ℕ+) ^ k ∣ m ↔ k ≤ m.factorMultiset.count p

name: count_modEq_card
informal: There are `b / r + [v % r < b % r]` numbers in `[0, b)` congruent to `v` mod `r`, where `[·]` is the Iverson bracket.
signature: (v : ℕ) : b.count (· ≡ v [MOD r]) = b / r + if v % r < b % r then 1 else 0

name: Finset.card_filter_length_eq_le
informal: The number of strings of length `s` in any finite set is at most `D^s`.
signature: [Fintype α] {T : Finset (List α)} {s : ℕ} : (T.filter (fun x => x.length = s)).card ≤ (Fintype.card α) ^ s

name: map_cast

name: iInf_nonneg
informal: As `⨅ i, f i = 0` when the domain of the real-valued function `f` is empty, it suffices to show that all values of `f` are nonnegative to show that `0 ≤ ⨅ i, f i`.
signature: (hf : ∀ i, 0 ≤ f i) : 0 ≤ iInf f

name: card_toMultiset
informal: Mapping an unordered pair to an unordered list produces a multiset of size `2`.
signature: {α : Type*} (z : Sym2 α) : z.toMultiset.card = 2

name: real_sqrt_le_nat_sqrt_succ
informal: The real square root is at most the natural square root plus one
signature: {a : ℕ} : √(a : ℝ) ≤ Nat.sqrt a + 1

name: IsAddTorsionFree.of_module_rat
informal: A `ℚ≥0`-module is torsion-free as a group. This instance will fire for any monoid `M`, so is local unless needed elsewhere.

informal: An element of `ℤ√d` has norm one (i.e., `a.re^2 - d*a.im^2 = 1`) if and only if it is contained in the submonoid of unitary elements. TODO: merge this result with `Pell.isPell_iff_mem_unitary`.

name: inf_eq_inf_and_sup_eq_sup
informal: In a linear order, two symmetric squares are equal if and only if they have the same infimum and supremum.
signature: [LinearOrder α] {s t : Sym2 α} : s.inf = t.inf ∧ s.sup = t.sup ↔ s = t

name: commute_iff
informal: Self-adjoint elements commute if and only if their product is self-adjoint.
signature: {R : Type*} [Mul R] [StarMul R] {x y : R} (hx : IsSelfAdjoint x) (hy : IsSelfAdjoint y) : Commute x y ↔ IsSelfAdjoint (x * y)

name: mahlerMeasure_le_sqrt_sum_sq_norm_coeff

signature: (p : Polynomial ℂ) : p.mahlerMeasure ≤ √(∑ i ∈ p.support, ‖p.coeff i‖ ^ 2)

informal: Unweighted mean inequality, version for two elements of `ℝ≥0` and real exponents.

name: nnnorm_sub_mul_self_le
